title: Chapter 102: Reward: Hiring the Pen Spirit
html:
“Mission Requirement: Find the Pen Spirit’s best friend and fulfill her wish.

“Mission Reward: The Pen Spirit’s affection will increase dramatically, giving you a chance to recruit her as an employee of the Haunted House!”

Chen Ge read the final sentence twice. Hiring a real ghost had always been his dream. He had never expected the opportunity to arrive so soon.

Ever since receiving the black phone, he had watched the My Team of Ghouls and Ghosts tab with particular interest. Yet after all his completed missions, it remained empty. For different reasons, neither Xiaoxiao nor Zhang Ya could be recruited. He had almost abandoned the idea; humans and ghosts simply belonged to different worlds. Now the black phone had finally offered him a chance.

The Pen Spirit would be an ideal employee. She could predict the future and frighten visitors without makeup or costumes.

I shall help the Pen Spirit fulfil her wish.

He slipped the black phone into his pocket and pushed through the crowd. Qin Guang’s employees were packing their equipment and laptop, preparing to leave. “Who said you could go?”

Approaching Fei Youliang, Chen Ge produced the name tag from his pocket. A woman’s name was written across its dirty surface: Chen Yalin.

“Why did he steal a prop from the Haunted House?” Chen Ge held up the name tag. “Don’t tell me this old thing belongs to Fei Youliang.”

Qin Guang’s employees exchanged baffled looks. They had no idea what had driven Fei Youliang to steal it.

“Xiao Chen, let me handle this.” Fearing a confrontation, Uncle Xu quickly stepped between them.

“First, they delete every recording from that laptop. Until then, no one leaves. I put too much work into these sets to have the whole attraction spoiled online.”

Uncle Xu understood the damage a public release could cause. He watched Qin Guang’s employees delete the footage, then escorted them to the park’s management office. Their conduct had harmed the park’s reputation, and management would discipline them accordingly.

Once they were gone, Chen Ge put them out of his mind. If anything, he pitied them for accidentally angering the Pen Spirit.

Xu Wan emerged from the Haunted House. “Boss, are we staying open for the rest of the day?”

“Of course.” Chen Ge returned to the ticket booth, where the once-orderly crowd immediately surrounded him.

“Brother, why isn’t the school scenario mentioned on the forum? It looks f*cking incredible!”

“Is the ticket to visit the school the same price?”

“Can four of us go in together? I’ve never been this excited and terrified at the same time. Someone hold me!”

After what they had witnessed, Chen Ge had not expected such enthusiasm for the new scenario. Then he noticed that most of the crowd were students.

“I’m sorry, but after today’s incident, the scenario will be closed for two days of maintenance.” Fei Youliang and Zhu Jianing had served as beta testers. Their experience proved that the scenario could terrify visitors without Chen Ge’s intervention, but too many uncertainties still made it dangerous.

Murder by Midnight had suffered similar problems at first. The mischievous Xiaoxiao followed Monkey and nearly frightened him to death. The situation improved only after Chen Ge completed that scenario’s Hidden Mission.

To have the lingering spirits inside Mu Yang High School listen to me, the simplest solution is to complete the scenario’s hidden mission.Chen Ge stuck his hand into his pocket, and with his fingers curled around the black phone, he came to a decision.

The Haunted House reopened, and the incident with Qin Guang’s employees soon faded into the background. Business kept Chen Ge occupied until 4:00 p.m., when the park began to empty. He let Xu Wan leave early, then entered Mu Yang High School alone.

Mu Yang High School was his first Two-Star Scenario. Its entrance stood at the foot of the stairs to the underground parking lot. No matter how far the attraction expanded underground, those stairs would remain fixed, making the school the first major scenario every visitor encountered.

He switched on his flashlight and headed to the sealed classroom. The fallen desks, chairs, and name tags had returned to their places, but one tag was missing.

“Can you hear me?” Chen Ge stood at the door and shouted into the room. The uniforms sat on their chairs, and there was no answer.

Shaking his head, Chen Ge went to the girls’ dormitory. He repaired the broken ballpoint pen, slipped it into his pocket, and continued to the well beyond the junction.

In the video, Fei Youliang had been talking to himself beside this well.

Several lingering spirits must have possessed him at once. That would explain the apparent nonsense.Chen Ge peered into the well. It was only two or three meters deep—not far enough to injure anyone who fell. Then why did they talk about jumping? Is the well hiding something else?

He thought of the door in the bathroom mirror, which appeared for only one minute after midnight, but found no answer. After one final inspection, he left the underground parking lot and replaced the wooden boards.

He retrieved 5,000 RMB from the staff break room, locked up, and went to the park’s management office. After repaying Uncle Xu, he asked about Qin Guang’s employees. Uncle Xu assured him that the matter had been handled.

With those errands complete, Chen Ge left the park and called Inspector Lee. Someone answered after three rings, but only tense breathing came through the line.

“Uncle San Bao?”

“What have you discovered this time?”

“It’s nothing—I just need your help to find a person.”

“Not a murder suspect?”

“No, just a normal student.”

Once he confirmed that, the silence on the other end broke. Footsteps resumed, papers rustled, and officers returned to their phone calls.

Inspector Lee sighed with relief. “I told them four times in one week would be too much. The stress you put my officers through…”

“Uncle San Bao, the person I’m looking for is Chen Yalin. She should be one of the victims from Mu Yang High School three years ago.”

“Victim? You’re looking for a dead person?”
